html:
SMTO-EXE-0203 — Text reading isn't set up on the computer with your PDF

GUID: 45cc7e89-b8e6-5ff0-9657-f7b6ddd237a6
Slug: pdf-ocr-unavailable
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: pdf

What happened

  • Reading words from scanned pages needs a text-reading program (Tesseract) on the Gateway computer. It is missing there, too old, or lacks the language you asked for. Nothing was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If you asked for a language other than English, try asking SMTO to read the PDF in English. English is installed by default; other languages need extra files on the Gateway computer.
  2. Ask the person who manages that computer to run the SMTO Gateway installer again on it, using the same account the Gateway runs under. The installer puts the text-reading program and its English data back in place without removing your Gateway setup.
  3. After the installer succeeds and nothing is running, restart the Gateway program, then open Settings › Setup › Gateways and select Check connection. The Gateway only notices newly installed programs after a restart, and SMTO needs to see its updated status.
  4. Start a new task and ask for the text again. A task already in progress keeps the list of features it saw when it started.

What success looks like

  • In a new task, SMTO returns the text from the scanned pages you asked about.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages the Gateway computer. Don't remove or re-pair the Gateway to fix this; the installer repairs it in place, and giving SMTO a skill permission does not install programs.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • PDF OCR could not start because the Gateway's Tesseract executable is missing, older than version 4, or lacks data for the requested language.

What this means

  • PDF OCR received the shared engine-unavailable category because Tesseract discovery/version checks or requested language availability failed. PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.

Why this can happen

  • PDF OCR received the shared engine-unavailable category because Tesseract discovery/version checks or requested language availability failed.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the selected Gateway's engine/version and installed language metadata; no remote OCR fallback is part of this path.

How to fix it

  • On the Gateway host, check that 'tesseract --version' reports 4 or newer and 'tesseract --list-langs' includes eng and every requested language. Repair in place by rerunning the installer as the Gateway's account (./install.sh, ./src/gateway_agent/install.sh, ./src/gateway_macos/install.sh or .\src\gateway_windows\install.ps1), install extra language data separately, then restart the Gateway after active work settles and start a new task; there is no cloud fallback.
  • If Tesseract or its English data is missing, reinstall or repair the affected Gateway by rerunning its supported installer on that Gateway host. After installation succeeds and active work is settled, restart the Gateway and refresh its metadata. Additional requested OCR languages need their own language data on the selected Gateway. No cloud fallback is performed.
  • If installation repair is indicated: From the matching repository checkout, run ./install.sh for the server and local Gateway, or use the Gateway-only installer: ./src/gateway_agent/install.sh on Linux, ./src/gateway_macos/install.sh on macOS, or .\src\gateway_windows\install.ps1 on Windows. Run it as the account used by the Gateway so its environment and browser caches are repaired.
  • After an installation repair: After active jobs and uncertain operations are reconciled, restart the affected Gateway. Restart the server too if the shared installer updated it. Refresh Gateway metadata before starting a new task.
  • Confirm the reported capability works on the selected Gateway after correcting its diagnosed cause. If installation repair was needed, require the installer checks to pass. Refresh metadata and start a new task when capabilities change; existing tasks keep their captured snapshot.

Retry and execution caution

  • Confirm the reported capability works on the selected Gateway after correcting its diagnosed cause. If installation repair was needed, require the installer checks to pass. Refresh metadata and start a new task when capabilities change; existing tasks keep their captured snapshot. Inspect prior execution receipts before repeating work.

How to verify the fix

  • The installed local engine supports the requested language and output mode before OCR begins.

What not to do

  • Never automatically replay uncertain writes or execute embedded document content.
  • Repair the installation in place; do not delete Gateway pairing, credentials, settings, browser profiles or task artifacts.
  • Granting a Skill permission does not install its dependencies.

Technical notes

  • PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
